headline:
Statistically cheap,
but analysts stay cautious
chart_note: 10-day range: $263.14 - $292.79, up 11% over the window - still about 21% below the 52-week high of $370.86.
why_today: Up slightly today, extending a 17% rally over the past month - but earnings growth has slowed to just 7.9% YoY.
pro_1: PEG ratio of just 0.70 is unusually low for a software company - the market may be underpricing the growth that is there
pro_2: 28.7% profit margin and a forward P/E of just 10.6x show a genuinely cash-generative, reasonably priced business
con_1: Analyst sentiment is notably lukewarm - more Hold ratings (23) than Buy/Strong Buy (12), plus 5 Sell ratings
con_2: RSI at 69 is close to overbought after a fast 17% run - earnings growth itself has cooled to single digits
